subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase to fill in the blank. 

Victor was abroad when the war _______ in his country.
solution:
Correct answer: **Option 2) broke out **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Broke out" means to start suddenly and spread. 
 
• In this sentence, "broke out" indicates that the war started suddenly and spread in Victor's country. &l
